newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Jilin estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jilin estimates cut.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it had lowered its 1996 earnings estimate for Jilin Chemical Industrial Co to 476 million yuan from 523 million and its 1997 earnings forecast to 479 million from 700 million for 1997.
In a report dated September 27, Merrill said it expects Jilin to book some losses in 1996 due to the start-up of the company's new ethylene facility.
"During the initial start-up of the 'Ethylene Project' facilities, we expect JCC to book some losses in H2 '96 before breaking even sometime in 1997," the report said.
"Management expects the project to contribute substantial profits during 1998 when the facilities are scheduled to run at relatively high and efficient operating rates," it added.

Merrill said it expects the ethylene facilities to run at between 60-70 percent capacity utilisation during their first year of operation in 1997. It also said it expects most of Jilin's product prices to be relatively stable to slightly lower from mid-1996 levels for most of 1997.

"Despite the downward earnings revision, we belive JCC's earnings prospects should not come as a surprise to the market as it is consistent with what management has been saying since the interim results announcement," Merrill Lynch said.

"We continue to recommend long-term investors to accumulate JCC shares on the back of the attractive value it offers both from a dividend yield perspective and its 34 percent discount to book value," it added.
